text:
erin: Hey team — two big personal updates: I'm getting married Sept 5 🎉 and accepted an internal move to Seattle (relocating in August). I'd love a small send-off potluck the last week of July. Also looking for local coffee recs and one song suggestion for the playlist. Thoughts?
noah: Huge congrats @erin!!! :tada: When's the potluck? count me in for cookies.
julia: omg congrats!!! Seattle is great — DM me if you want neighborhood recs (Capitol Hill bakeries are 🔥).
matt: Congrats!! I'll bring something savory and nominate 'Dog Days Are Over' for the playlist :grin:.
sasha: :heart: congrats! I can bring plates + napkins.
ops-bot: calendar: Event created — "Erin send-off potluck" on 2025-07-26 12:00-13:00 in the kitchen. Invite: @channel
erin: Amazing, thanks!! Quick poll — cake vs doughnuts vs savory? react with :cake: :doughnut: :sandwich: or reply. Please RSVP with `/yes` in thread if you're coming.
noah: reacted :cake: and did `/yes`
julia: doughnuts + `/yes`
matt: savory + `/yes` — can help haul a folding table.
erin: Love it, added the playlist suggestions so far. If anyone wants to add a song drop it here or ping me. Thanks for the love ❤️
